headline: Argentine Manufacturing Output Declines for Ninth Consecutive Month
summary: Argentine manufacturing production fell 0.2% monthly and 3.4% year-on-year in September, marking nine straight months of negative balances according to industrial union estimates.
why: Industrial production data serves as a core gauge of economic health and manufacturing sector activity in Argentina.

impacts.name: Industrial Goods
impacts.why: Persistent contractions in manufacturing output reflect subdued domestic demand and industrial activity.
